dishes.name: Grünkohl mit Pinkel
dishes.desc: Winter kale stewed with smoked Pinkel sausage and bacon, with potatoes. The signature dish of Oldenburg and its Kohlfahrt tradition.

dishes.name: Friesentorte
dishes.desc: Layered puff-pastry cake with cream and plum jam, a classic of East Frisia and Oldenburg cafés.

dishes.name: North Sea shrimp
dishes.desc: Small brown shrimp caught off the East Frisian coast and eaten on bread or in a bowl, fresh from the harbour.

dishes.name: Ostfriesischer Rosinenstuten
dishes.desc: Sweet, soft raisin loaf, served with tea in East Frisian homes and bakeries.

dishes.name: Oldenburger Entenbraten
dishes.desc: Roast duck with red cabbage and dumplings, a famous Oldenburg dinner dish with duck farming ties.
